WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, member_key, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from, valid_to,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY member_id) AS nver
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT 'members' AS k, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS a, COUNT(*) AS b, MIN(join_date) AS c, MAX(join_date) AS d FROM dim_member
UNION ALL SELECT 'fy2526 first versions', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'first-version valid_from != join_date', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date) FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND valid_from<>join_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'join_date differs across versions', COUNT(DISTINCT member_id), 0, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dup member_key', COUNT(*), 0, NULL, NULL FROM (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'cal2025 first versions', COUNT(*), 0, NULL, NULL FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND year(join_date)=2025

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member),
nm AS (SELECT * FROM fv WHERE vn=1 AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03')
SELECT nm.home_store_id, cs.store_name, cs.city, cs.region, cs.format, cs.open_date, cs.close_date, COUNT(*) AS new_members,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_store x WHERE x.store_id=nm.home_store_id) AS nversions
FROM nm LEFT JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=nm.home_store_id AND cs.is_current
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from, member_key) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT home_store_id, MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date), COUNT(*), COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE join_date>DATE '2026-01-25') AS after_close,
 COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_trading_day IS NOT TRUE) AS nontrading
FROM fv LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=fv.join_date
WHERE vn=1 AND home_store_id IN (129,900,105) AND join_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY 1
